summary: Fresh v3.30 launch succeeded. Initial G7 recovery ownership was later fenced by G8 before a valid RETURN; the worker then performed bounded resident reallocation. Four subsequent authority CREATEs were proven CREATE_EXISTS, including one EFF034 refresh and one POOL_TAIL_RESCUE, reaching the binding authority-create hard cap. No productive slot is claimed.

friction_events.description: The initial recovery capsule referenced multiple absent current-main paths and G7 was superseded by G8 before a generation-valid RETURN could be emitted.
Resident reallocation produced four proven CREATE_EXISTS collisions; one EFF034 refresh and the single permitted POOL tail rescue were used before the hard cap.
Direct public exit-page fetch returned a cache miss; the exact gh-pages wc/exit/index.html source was read instead.

decision_trace.decision: Fence the initial G7 work rather than emit a stale-generation RETURN.
decision_trace.observable_basis: G000008 existed with a different current worker after G7 expired.
decision_trace.action: Persisted a non-productive runtime observation and re-entered compact allocation.
decision_trace.outcome: No stale source mutation or stale RETURN was published.

decision_trace.decision: Refresh compact frontier after two recovery collisions on a snapshot older than 90 seconds.
decision_trace.observable_basis: EFF034 stale-collision refresh condition was met.
decision_trace.action: Refreshed once, reused beacon shard seed, rebuilt capability filter.
decision_trace.outcome: A new GUIDE_INTEGRATOR rescue candidate surfaced but its atomic CREATE also returned CREATE_EXISTS.

decision_trace.decision: Stop authority creation at the binding hard cap.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Three ordinary CREATE attempts plus one pool-tail rescue all collided.
decision_trace.action: Persisted no-allocation boundary and terminal E9 exam.
decision_trace.outcome: Closed below target without bypassing ownership rules.

top_time_sinks.note: Initial claimed capsule became generation-fenced before valid completion.
Four reallocation CREATE_EXISTS outcomes consumed the bounded authority budget.

unfinished_debt.item: Allocator should suppress or repoint primary-chat async-QA recovery capsules whose declared current-main source refs are absent.
High-contention compact-frontier candidates should age out faster after successful claims so fresh workers spend fewer CREATE attempts on already-owned paths.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Compile a current-owner existence check into recovery eligibility for declared exact source refs.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce stale recovery claims that cannot safely satisfy acceptance criteria.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Shorten frontier visibility of paths immediately after successful atomic claims or project a claim-taken hint without changing CREATE authority.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce bounded CREATE_EXISTS contention while preserving atomic-create truth.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh worker identity was created successfully. Initial work was safely fenced when a newer generation appeared. Resident reallocation then hit four proven ownership collisions, including the single allowed refreshed rescue, so the worker closed at the authority-create hard cap with zero productive slots and durable evidence rather than bypassing coordination.
